description: National Library of Scotland georeferenced map layers covering the West Ham study area, 1800-1920. Tile URL templates observed on 25 September 2026 in the NLS tileset bucket used by the NLS seamless viewers; the official hosted route is MapTiler Cloud (see WEBSITE_PLAN.md). Series titles and date ranges follow NLS layer naming and the NLS Historic Maps API layer list; verify individual sheet dates against sheet margins before citing.
licence: Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY): NLS Historic Maps API layers are CC BY 3.0; NLS map images re-usable under CC-BY per https://maps.nls.uk/copyright.html
attribution: Reproduced with the permission of the National Library of Scotland (https://maps.nls.uk/)
study_bbox_note: West Ham 1911 borough bounding box (lon -0.0195..0.0528, lat 51.4961..51.5555) with roughly 1.2 km margin, so Bromley-by-Bow, Three Mills, Hackney Wick, the Thames south bank and the East Ham edge are included.

layers.title: OS London skeleton survey, 1:5,280 (12 inches to the mile)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey skeleton plan of London for the Metropolitan Commission of Sewers (identification provisional)
layers.notes: Sample tile at Abbey Mills shows roads, Mill Lane, Abbey Mill Tavern and bench marks only, consistent with the skeleton survey. Earliest large-scale coverage of West Ham in the bucket.

layers.title: OS London town plan, first edition, 1:1,056 (NLS folder London-1870s)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey London, five feet to the mile, first edition
layers.dates: c.1862-1875 (verify per sheet; Abbey Mills area shows the Northern Outfall Sewer but no pumping station, so surveyed before c.1865 there)
layers.notes: Served to zoom 20; downloaded to 18 to match the 1893 layer. East edge of coverage at about 0.049 E, so Silvertown east and the Royal Albert Dock edge are outside. Download: 4,619 tiles present, 3,636 absent; coverage is partial within the box.

layers.title: OS One-inch Old Series (first edition), England and Wales
layers.series: Ordnance Survey One-inch to the mile, Old Series
layers.notes: NLS serves this layer only to zoom 9 (overview resolution). Earliest OS coverage of West Ham.

layers.title: OS Six-inch first edition, Essex
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Six-inch to the mile, County Series first edition
layers.notes: Sample tile shows West Ham Abbey Print Works, chemical and tar works and Abbey Mills before the pumping station labelling: first edition. A second scan set exists at os/six-inch-essexV.

layers.title: OS Six-inch first edition, Middlesex (west bank of the Lea)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Six-inch to the mile, County Series first edition
layers.notes: Covers Bow, Bromley-by-Bow and Old Ford opposite West Ham; tiles east of the Lea are blank.

layers.title: OS Six-inch first edition, Kent (Thames south bank)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Six-inch to the mile, County Series first edition
layers.notes: Context only: North Woolwich is Kent detached; south-bank Woolwich and Greenwich marshes.

layers.title: OS Six-inch second edition, England and Wales
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Six-inch to the mile, County Series second edition
layers.notes: Seamless mosaic across county boundaries; sheet dates vary within the range.

layers.title: OS 25-inch, London sheets
layers.series: Ordnance Survey 1:2,500 County Series, London
layers.dates: 1893-1896 revision and later editions to c.1916 (verify per sheet)
layers.notes: Covers West Ham fully; the separate 25_inch/essex layer does not. Sample tile shows Abbey Mills Pumping Station and Mill Meads. Download: 7,934 tiles present, 2,301 absent at the east and north-east edges where the London sheets end.

layers.title: OS 25-inch, Middlesex (west bank of the Lea)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey 1:2,500 County Series, Middlesex
layers.notes: Downloaded 25 Sept 2026: only 2 low-zoom tiles exist inside the study box; the Middlesex 25-inch layer stops short of the Lea here, so Bromley-by-Bow is covered by the London 25-inch layer instead. Kept for completeness.

layers.title: OS London, five feet to the mile (1:1,056), 1893-1896
layers.series: Ordnance Survey London Town Plan, 1:1,056, revision of 1891-1895
layers.notes: Native detail to about zoom 18; zooms 19-20 are upsampled. Sheet index with revision dates: data/maps/metadata_nls_os_london_1056_2026-09-23_091420.geojson. MapTiler Cloud layer id uk-oslondon1k1893.

layers.title: OS London, 1:12,500 (date to be established)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey London series, 1:12,500
layers.dates: uncertain; labels Abbey Mills as an L.C.C. sewage pumping station, so 1889 or later
layers.notes: Included for identification; may post-date 1920. Check sheet margins before use.

layers.title: OS One-inch Revised New Series, England and Wales (outline)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey One-inch to the mile, Revised New Series
layers.notes: Uncoloured engraving. Already used by the industrial swipe map as its period basemap.

layers.title: OS One-inch Revised New Series, coloured
layers.series: Ordnance Survey One-inch to the mile, Revised New Series (coloured)

layers.title: OS One-inch Third Edition, coloured, England and Wales
layers.series: Ordnance Survey One-inch to the mile, Third Edition (Large Sheet Series)

layers.title: OS Half-inch, layer coloured, England and Wales
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Half-inch to the mile

layers.title: OS Half-inch Large Sheet Series, hills, England and Wales
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Half-inch to the mile, Large Sheet Series

layers.title: OS Quarter-inch first edition, hills
layers.series: Ordnance Survey Quarter-inch to the mile, first edition

layers.title: Bartholomew Half-inch, Great Britain
layers.series: John Bartholomew & Co., Half-inch to the mile (Reduced Ordnance Survey)

layers.title: OS One-inch Popular Edition, England and Wales (edge of period)
layers.series: Ordnance Survey One-inch to the mile, Popular Edition
layers.notes: Begins at the end of the study period; included for the 1914-1920 bookend.

layers.title: Bartholomew Half-inch, England and Wales, 1920s (edge of period)
layers.series: John Bartholomew & Son, Half-inch to the mile
layers.notes: Just outside the period; kept as the closest post-war comparison.

excluded.reason: no tiles over West Ham at zoom 14 or above; the London 25-inch layer carries these sheets
1:2,500 National Grid mapping of the 1950s (Allotment Gardens, post-war detail); outside 1800-1920
OS town plans exist for other towns; none for West Ham, Stratford, Canning Town or Silvertown (London sets checked separately)
